prompt: A gutkurr (Gutkurr), a Star Wars canon creature. Gutkurrs were fierce insectile predators native to the planet Ryloth. They were aggressive and displayed very limited intelligence, however they were observed to work in small hunting packs. These traits however has made them popular game animals and "pets" for criminal organisations across the galaxy, spreading these monsterous creatures to many worlds. RimWorld top-down pawn sprite, desert-world creature, painterly game-art style matching the existing RimWorld/Star Wars mod roster, clean silhouette, transparent background.
style_notes: RimWorld creature sprite, Star Wars desert bestiary, our own art (not the donor mod's).
